title: Topology and character sectors in monopole L2-cohomology
exact_target: Give topological descriptions, asymptotics and vanishing results for L² cohomology of monopole and special-holonomy moduli spaces.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002529 (AIM-PHYSICS-0037). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, $L^2$ harmonic forms in geometry and string theory; notes by Anda Degeratu and Mark Haskins, March 2004, 21 March 2004, Hunsicker questions.

status_qualification: The title names character sectors, but the full source asks about the entire moduli-space cohomology and geometric programme. Source remarks about known SU(2) constructions are historical context and do not establish surjectivity here. The surjectivity question in the source remarks and the following anonymous extended-form question are recorded explicitly; the latter is not attributed to Hunsicker. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
